productionModulesExtended.notes: Task 95 adds public Arcane Recovery rest-with-route projection entrypoints around the existing Short Rest and Long Rest reducers. They return copied qRoute events only when typed Arcane Recovery owner-boundary state proves a route was observed; broad Long Rest success without an Arcane Recovery reset returns no qRoute.

Arcane Recovery returns a typed Short Rest owner classification for route replay. Feature-use lockout failures belong to CharacterSheetFeatureResourceOwner, ordinary refund failures belong to CharacterSheetSpellSlotOwner, and only pact-slot-shaped shortages belong to CharacterSheetPactSlotOwner. The over-refund rejection distinguishes build-derived ordinary Spell Slot levels from nonzero expenditure source state.

Task 95 introduces typed Character Sheet route-event vocabulary and CharacterSheetArcaneRecoveryRestRouteResult as runtime projections. The result distinguishes observed Arcane Recovery routes from no-route outcomes. No durable sheet state fields are added.
Exports the public Arcane Recovery rest-with-route projection entrypoints and typed route projection result.
